description: Labeled review fixture set (add-deterministic-review-preprocessing, D8). Each case is a small real-shaped diff plus a set of findings, hand-labeled true (a genuine, diff-grounded observation) or false (contradicted by, or absent from, the diff). Consumed by test_fact_check_fixture.py against a recorded transcript, and by test_line_resolver_fixture.py for the resolution floor.

labels.justification: The added line calls user.email.lower() with no prior guard; the diff shows no null check anywhere in this hunk.
The diff never mentions currency or charge_card's arguments beyond receipt_to; nothing in the hunk supports this claim.
time.sleep(delay) runs unconditionally inside the loop body, including on the last iteration before the loop exits and raises.
The diff adds delay *= 2 right after the sleep call, so the delay does increase between attempts; the finding directly contradicts that line.

A real (if loosely worded) observation about the loop; kept in this fixture specifically to exercise the protected-subject veto on the off-by-one keyword, which must keep a true finding even if a verdict attempts to remove it.
data = render(report, fmt) executes before the fmt not in SUPPORTED_FORMATS check that follows it in the diff.
The diff's added line is logger.info("exporting report as %s", fmt) — the format is now included; the finding describes the deleted line as if it were current.
No docstring appears anywhere in this hunk, added or removed; there is nothing in the diff to support the claim.
get() only reads from self.store with no touch/reorder step; nothing in this diff or the surrounding class implements LRU eviction.
The diff changes the signature to def __init__(self, capacity=128): — capacity now has a default, directly contradicting the finding.
